name: agent-badge
description: Per-window tmux status badges showing what every Claude Code and Codex session in your tmux server is doing.

interface.shortDescription: tmux window badges for agent sessions
interface.longDescription: Adds a per-window badge to the tmux status bar showing what every Claude Code and Codex session is doing -- working, finished, blocked on a permission decision, or compacting -- so you can tell at a glance which window wants you.
